name: poc
description: Generic tenant smoke for forge's crawl phase (the default journey every `forge build` looks for). Tenant-agnostic on purpose: it drives only the root route, which every Forge tenant serves, catching console errors, failed requests, CSP violations and missing assets above and below the fold. Serve the tenant's static/ on 127.0.0.1:8123 before the build (e.g. `python3 -m http.server 8123 -d static`) or the crawl phase degrades to a dev-server-down warn.
